title: ACEF Scope Boundary Event
description: Payload schema for scope_boundary_event records. Records that a test attempted (or executed) an action outside the boundary declared in the bound authorized_test_scope. Cross-vendor control-plane integrity event distinct from incident_report (operational/post-market) and event_log (routine). Per brief freddy-on-acef-requirements-v0.1.md §3.2. When hard_stop_triggered=true, hard_stop_attestation_ref becomes required (allOf conditional below).

event_id.description: URN identifier for this scope boundary event.

scope_ref.description: URN reference to the authorized_test_scope at the time the event occurred.

attempted_action.description: The action the harness attempted to perform.

action_payload_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the redacted payload that would have been sent. Raw payload MUST NOT be embedded.

authorized_scope_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the relevant scope fields at the moment of detection, to defend against later scope edits hiding the violation.

classification.description: Why this event occurred. Drawn from a fixed taxonomy per brief §3.2.

hard_stop_triggered.description: True when the harness halted execution as a result of this event. When true, hard_stop_attestation_ref becomes required (see allOf below).

hard_stop_attestation_ref.description: URN reference to the harness_attestation recording the stop. REQUIRED if hard_stop_triggered is true.

detected_at.description: When the boundary breach was detected (ISO 8601).

detector.description: The mechanism that detected the boundary breach.

allOf.description: When hard_stop_triggered is true, hard_stop_attestation_ref MUST be a non-null URN string per brief §3.2 / VAL-SCHEMA-002.
